notes.title: Tiny Bunny EP 2 is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1421250/header.jpg?t=1618585210[/img]
Beware! Our bunny grew some teeth. The game features graphic scenes, explicit language and depictions of psychological violence. Please play responsibly. The age rating at the moment is 16+.
The game is also fully voiced in Russian now. The voice-over can be turned off in the settings. We recommend playing alone with the default audio settings and using a headset for the full experience.
Cheers, "Tiny Bunny" dev team.

notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421250/TINY_BUNNY/?beta=0
The full version of the "[b]Tiny Bunny[/b]" novel will gradually appear on the new page on Steam. Follow the link in the profile header. Hurry up to add to your [u][b]Wish List[/b][/u]! Hurrah! 🐰 In the meantime, we are preparing the second episode for release.
